routes.description: Establish that the cited facts do not comparatively confirm naturalism over theism because their likelihood on naturalism is not established, theism can accommodate them through soul-building, or skeptical theism blocks the required comparative likelihood judgment.
routes.successCriteria: The route succeeds if at least one burden-completing defense prevents the pain, pleasure, languishing, and horrendous-evil facts from furnishing a justified comparative evidential advantage for naturalism over theism.

motionBridge.description: Show that the disputed suffering facts do not warrant the conclusion that naturalism is comparatively confirmed over theism.

centralBridges.description: Require justification before treating naturalism as predicting the biological orientation, distribution, and severity of suffering better than theism.
Connect significant suffering to freedom, virtue formation, relationship, whole-life integration, or eventual defeat in a theistic account.
Establish that limited human access to theism's relevant reasons or probability assignments undercuts the proposed comparative likelihood inference.

subsidiaryBridges.description: Address whether the theistic account covers nonhuman suffering, horrendous evil, and less harmful proposed alternatives.
Explain how additional theistic considerations bear on the claimed evidential balance without replacing the comparison at issue.

routes.description: Establish that biologically oriented pain and pleasure, widespread languishing, and horrendous evil are less surprising under naturalism than under theism, while answering soul-building and skeptical-theist attempts to neutralize that comparison.
routes.successCriteria: The route succeeds if one or more cited classes of suffering retain a warranted likelihood advantage for naturalism after the proposed theistic explanations and epistemic undercutters are incorporated.

motionBridge.description: Show that the observed suffering facts are sufficiently more expected on naturalism to count as evidence for it over theism.

centralBridges.description: Establish a comparative expectation favoring naturalism from the predominantly biological orientation of pain and pleasure.
Establish a comparative expectation favoring naturalism from the prevalence and distribution of languishing among sentient beings.
Establish a comparative expectation favoring naturalism from suffering that threatens persons' ability to find their lives worthwhile.
Show why soul-building and skeptical-theist uncertainty do not eliminate the accessible comparative evidential reasons.

subsidiaryBridges.description: Defend the defeasible inductive and background-knowledge basis used to derive naturalistic expectations.
Address less harmful formative alternatives, nonhuman scope, eventual defeat, and the symmetrical bearing of unknown reasons.

sections.title: Biological Orientation of Pain and Pleasure
sections.rationale: This issue tests whether the functional pattern of pain and pleasure supplies a warranted naturalistic likelihood advantage or admits a theistic moral-role explanation.

sections.title: Distribution of Flourishing and Languishing
sections.rationale: This issue concerns whether widespread deprivation, predation, disease, and limited flourishing are comparatively expected under the competing worldviews.

sections.title: Horrendous Evil and Divine Permission
sections.rationale: This issue examines how morally blind causation, divine empathy, relationship with God, and psychological destruction affect the likelihood of horrendous suffering.

sections.title: Soul-Building, Alternatives, and Defeat
sections.rationale: This issue tests whether virtue formation, freedom, whole-life integration, nonhuman scope, less harmful alternatives, and eventual defeat can account for the observed suffering.

sections.title: Skeptical Theism and Comparative Confirmation
sections.rationale: This issue determines whether uncertainty about divine reasons blocks comparative confirmation or leaves accessible evidence capable of favoring naturalism despite unknown considerations.
